title: M2.8: Deliverability: bounce, complaint, suppression and kill switch
description:
Complete event handling: permanent bounce suppresses the address for the binding; complaint suppresses for the organization and disables the binding's outbound pending owner review; soft bounces retry within bounds; environment-wide kill switch pauses all external outbound when complaint or bounce rate crosses a threshold before SES does; owner-visible deliverability state.

Acceptance criteria:
- Mailbox simulator bounce and complaint payloads produce the suppression and disable behavior
- A suppressed address is not sent to again; owner can remove a suppression with an audit record
- Kill switch stops delivery handler sends and leaves messages pending with a visible reason

Gherkin: features/email_deliverability.feature

Depends on: M1.8

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
